entities.summary: 91 Aquarii b, also known as HD 219449 b, is an extrasolar planet orbiting in the 91 Aquarii system approximately 148 light-years away in the constellation of Aquarius. It orbits at the average distance of 105 million km from its star, which is slightly closer than Venus is to the sun. The planet takes half an Earth year to orbit around the star in a very circular orbit with eccentricity less than 0.053.
